points.description: States that reservoir routing reduces (attenuates) the peak discharge/flow, i.e. the outflow peak is lower than the inflow peak.
States that the peak flow is shifted in time (the outflow peak is delayed/lagged relative to the inflow peak).

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) only if both aspects are stated precisely: the peak discharge is reduced (attenuated) and the peak is shifted/delayed in time. Give 1 mark for one correct aspect only. Vague statements such as "controls the flood" or "stores water", or any wrong extra aspect, earn nothing for the affected point.
